title: Definition
description: Schema for a definition — reusable truth. Composes identity/provenance/quantity/support-status fragments and adds definition-only fields (composition, parameters with default:, behaviors/enables, properties, support, extensions). Enforces anti-placeholder Rules 1 and 2 conditionally on origin.

layer.description: Which layer this definition lives at. See OBJECT-MODEL.md §4.

composition.description: What this object is built from. At least one of 'uses' (exact) or 'requires' (role-based) must be present. See OBJECT-MODEL.md §6.

requires.description: Role-based dependencies. Each key is a role id; each value declares kind + capability requirements.

enables.description: Latent capabilities for material/shape/interface kinds. Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §6.

behaviors.description: Behaviors this object adopts. For primitive_device and up per OBJECT-MODEL.md §6.

parameters.description: Parameter slot declarations. Each slot has a type, optional default, optional satisfies_role linking to a composition role. Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §13.

satisfies_role.description: Links this parameter to a composition.requires role with the same id.

default.description: Optional cited default. Allowed on definitions; forbidden on instances.

properties.description: Physical-property values (resistivity, density, etc.). Each property carries a value, optional provenance, optional support. Anti-placeholder Rule 1: provenance is required on builtin/community origins (enforced conditionally below).

state_machine.description: Optional declarative description of the device's internal state machine. Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §6.5. Sprint 6+: descriptive only — the validator checks internal consistency (transitions reference declared states; initial_state is declared); runtime state tracking and FSM evaluation are future canvas/simulator concerns. Only stateful devices (switches, relays, MOSFETs, latches) declare a state_machine; static devices (resistor, capacitor, wire, power_source) do not.

initial_state.description: Id of the state the device starts in. Must reference a key declared in 'states'.

states.description: Discrete states the device can occupy, keyed by state id. At least 2 states required (a single-state machine is not a machine).

transitions.description: Allowed transitions between states. Sprint 6 leaves 'trigger' as a free string; formal trigger taxonomy is deferred until 3+ stateful device types exist.

from.description: State id the transition leaves. Cross-FK validates this references a declared state.

to.description: State id the transition enters. Cross-FK validates this references a declared state.

trigger.description: Free-string description of what causes this transition. Examples today: 'actuated' (toggle), 'actuated_while_held' (momentary), 'released', 'current_through_coil' (relay), 'gate_voltage_above_threshold' (MOSFET). Enum hardens in a future sprint.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the transition.

allOf.description: Anti-placeholder Rule 1 + Rule 2: at builtin and community origins, properties must have provenance, parameter defaults must have provenance, and all values use value_strict (which excludes unknown_user_supplied). Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §12.
